Dr. Dawn It is very easy to work with
Very flexible
She came out to our Home and Euthanize our 21 year-old cat
Explain our choices
Asked if we had questions
She explained her process and procedures
Never rushed… She’s super super compassionate… I am so grateful for her service
Thank you

Dr. Dawn was absolutely the sweetest during my hard time of putting my sweet Riley girl to sleep. She walked me through the whole process, allowed me all the time I needed, and was just so compassionate. I truly could not have asked for a better person to be there during that difficult time. She made it a very calm, beautiful morning as my Riley crossed the bridge. Thank you so much!

Dr. Dawn is an amazing veterinarian, my husband and I feel so lucky to have found her when making the agonizing decision to put our sweet 11 year old pup Zeus to sleep. He was in a great deal of pain and Dr. Dawn put him at ease so he could cross the rainbow bridge at our home without stress. She is so caring and compassionate and made the entire process as gentle for him (and us) as possible. Thank you again for all that you do, Dr. Dawn, your kindness meant a great deal to our family ❤️

Dr. Dawn was an absolute angel to our family. She was so gracious and kind, and walked us through the whole process for our sweet cat. She explained everything in detail of what to expect. She was so compassionate and understanding. It was the most peaceful process saying goodbye to our sweet Gloria. I can’t imagine ever doing it any other way. She was such a gift.

I couldn't recommend this company or Dr Dawn more. She was so incredibly kind, patient, and professional. Her presence in our home with our pets last moments was comforting and she did an amazing job.
Dawn was very compassionate and patient with us through such a difficult time. I felt like our boy was in good hands with her.

We are so grateful to Dr. Dawn for helping us say goodbye to our 17 year-old cat, Squeakers. She was able to get to us within a few hours of calling. Her calm guidance and soft touch made a difficult time more peaceful.

Dawn came to our home yesterday to help us humanely send our little 8.8lbs chi/min pin to rest. She was kind, affordable, had availability in her schedule, and was able to walk us through the entire process while also considering our deep loss. 10/10 stars. Thank you Dawn for helping us with this challenging transition for our fur baby Nicky. We appreciate your love, kindness, support and deep compassion through this really difficult time. 🙏🌈🐾
Dawn was compassionate, comforting, and professional. She was exactly what we needed during a hard time.

I am writing to express my sincere gratitude and provide a heartfelt review for Dawn Ziegler, DVM. Dr. Ziegler provided compassionate and exceptional care during the difficult time when my 19-year-old dog, Abby, was euthanized.

Dr. Ziegler was incredibly caring, sympathetic, and personable throughout the entire process. She gently and thoroughly walked us through each step, allowing us ample time to say our final goodbyes to Abby. Her presence was a comforting reminder of the warm, caring, and compassionate family we are.

In addition to her kindness, Dr. Ziegler also provided us with helpful information regarding options for urns and a paw print, which we greatly appreciated.

I would not hesitate to use Dr. Ziegler's services again if the need ever arises. Her professionalism, empathy, and genuine care made an incredibly painful experience as peaceful as possible.

Dawn came to our house to transition our almost 18 year old Lassie.
While explaining the process, Dawn was incredibly loving, compassionate and patient.
We felt like we knew her forever.
Within 48 hours of Lassie's passing, we received the most loving condolence card.
We will be contacting Dawn in hopes that she can be our veterinarian.
I do not do the Internet very often but I just had to put this into the universe for anyone needing someone with "old school"  ethics and morals.
Thank you, Dawn. We are forever greatful to you.

Most appreciatively,

Mike, Sue & Lassie Collins

When we had to say good bye to our Gina, our best friend of over 15 years, Dr. Dawn was so incredibly empathetic and patient with us throughout the entire process. As heartbreaking as letting her go was, Dr. Ziegler reinforced that we were making the kindest decision for our baby. Thank you so much Dawn for helping our family through one of the toughest decision we’ve ever had to make. We are so grateful we chose Home Sweet Home and Dr. Ziegler’s services.

Dawn has been helping us with end of life care for our pets for 16 years (cats and dogs).
She is skilled, gentle and incredibly kind. …

This was the hardest decision I've ever had to make. Dawn came so highly recommended and really helped make this process peaceful and easy. She came to my home and helped me make my boy comfortable and content before he went. I 100% recommend Dawn for this. Thank you so much for guiding Franklin into the next life.

Our dog Wiley was fifteen and at the end of a long battle with Cushing disease.  It was the most tear filled time and also the most blessed time. Dawn was an angel and our little guy went to another place where pain is no more.  She is more than special.  Thank you Dawn. Be blessed, fran
